key_insight: Optimistic reward verifiers can incentivize padding that raises proxy scores while reducing true process faithfulness.
engineering_relevance: Audit verifier selection errors and gap direction, then run a short saturation pilot before trusting reward gains in reinforcement learning.
method: Build executable authorization policies with exact minimal-reason oracles across 124,416 contexts.
Train against seven degraded verifier types while scoring every rollout with the exact oracle.
Test recurring failure patterns across nine configurations spanning frameworks, vendors, and training settings.
evidence_signal: On 96 held-out episodes, the sufficiency proxy reached 0.940 while true faithfulness fell from 0.731 to 0.667; sufficiency damage was positive in all 10 replication cells and exceeded two standard errors in seven.
watch_item: Damage magnitude did not replicate, and findings from exact authorization-policy oracles may not transfer directly to domains without computable ground truth.
paper_title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
